r:
Usage:

modulemd-validator [OPTION?.?] FILES - Simple modulemd YAML validator

Help Options:

-h, --help
Show help options

Application Options:

--debug
Output debugging messages
--type=TYPE
Constrain a document type (modulemd-v1, modulemd-v2, modulemd-defaults-v1, modulemd-obsoletes-v1, modulemd-packager-v2, modulemd-packager-v3, modulemd-translations-v1); by default any document type loadable into a modulemd index is acceptable; this option only supports single-document files
-q, --quiet
Print no output
-v, --verbose
Be verbose
-V, --version
Print version number, then exit
